### 1️⃣ DeepSeek V4 AI Beats Billion Dollar Systems…For Free
DeepSeek V4 is a massive 58-page paper release. 1M token context window, Pro model matches frontier models, Flash model needs 10x less compute. **Three innovations** for KV-cache compression:
- **Token-level compression** (summarize paragraphs)
- **Heavily Compressed Attention** (128-to-1, like a table of contents)
- **Compressed Sparse Attention** (index-like lookup)
→ **90% memory reduction.** Pro beats Gemini 3.1 Pro on long-context recall. Pricing up to **30x cheaper than Claude.** Caveats: unimodal (text only - no images/audio), some training techniques not fully understood, still degrades at context limit.

### 2️⃣ NVIDIA's New AI Turns One Photo Into A World That Never Breaks (Lyra 2.0)
Takes one photo → consistent 3D explorable world. Previous systems (Genie 3, etc.) lacked object permanence and broke down over time. Lyra 2.0 uses a **per-frame 3D geometry cache** (depth map + downsampled point cloud) — each view gets its own snapshot instead of a global scene. **Worlds never break** when you look away and back. Limitations: static scenes only, inherits lighting/exposure flaws from training data, 3D floaters. All open source.

### 3️⃣ Sakana AI's God Simulator Is Brilliant
A digital petri dish where AI species (neural cellular automata) compete for territory. You tweak environmental parameters like "easy money" or "tough economy" and watch empires rise and fall. **Three stages:** Permissive mixing → Crystallization (hard borders) → Relaxation (beautiful checkerboard/stripe patterns emerge). Brilliant metaphor for markets, ecosystems, and **life advice** — be loose to explore, then harden to find your shape, then loosen again to grow.
